method.native_RGB_hash: MD5 of each ffmpeg-decoded 1920x1080 RGB24 frame; composition relation only
method.triage_descriptor: 240x135 area-resampled source RGB; tight red, skin and dark class masks
method.unknowns_policy: No fuzzy/temporal/camera equivalence merges. Every frame retains original frame/PTS and an exact-composition candidate. Unverified states remain possible_missing; hidden state unknown even when visible sample is known.

status_semantics.known: exact composited RGB sample or bounded reviewed visible state; NOT full unobscured author cel
status_semantics.possible_missing: drawing equivalence not established; not a declaration of a new drawing
status_semantics.occluded: bounded review cannot establish covered drawing identity
status_semantics.transform_only: reserved for independently proved transforms; never inferred from descriptor similarity
